questions.question: What should come in place of the question (?) in the given series based on the English alphabetical order? IGK, LJN, OMQ, RPT, ? [SSC Steno 2024 Eng]
questions.questionHtml:

IGK, LJN, OMQ, RPT, ?
[SSC Steno 2024 Eng]
questions.solution: Gap of +3 is in the pattern like R+3 is U, P+3 is S and T+3 is W.

questions.question: If every letter in the word IMAGINATION is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order and the letters of the new word are arranged in alphabetical order, which letter will be the sixth from the left end of the new word thus formed? Note: The new word formed after performing the mentioned operations may not necessarily be a meaningful English word. [SSC Steno 2024 Eng]

questions.question: Four words are EQUATION, MATHS, WINTER and RAIN. When counted from the left, if every fourth letter in each of the above words is changed to the previous letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have no letter appearing more than once? [SSC Steno 2024 Eng]
